item.title: It’s too bad I woke up again this morning
item.description:
Early in the Day

As soon as I woke up today, I immediately started doing the same activities over and over again, just like yesterday, but I won’t go into detail here.

Midday

Since it’s October now, that means the weather is at its hottest in the southern part of the Earth, near the equator, so I spent my time sitting in front of a fan
